purpose: Messbarer Fortschritt des Trading-Agent-Projekts ohne Rendite- oder Sicherheitsversprechen.

measurable_next_gates.criterion: CI green on current governance/engineering branch and state freshness guard active
At least one formally governed Q017 candidate with fixed rule, point-in-time contract, costs, falsification criterion and no post-observation selection
Complete required historical coverage on a fresh symbol-disjoint universe; otherwise DATA_INSUFFICIENT
One authorized fixed-rule trial evaluated against unchanged evidence gates and holdout-blind until the defined evaluation stage
Evidence survives predefined OOS/rolling/risk/control-relative checks without parameter or asset reselection
Only after prior gates pass: paper-only forward operation with realized P&L, slippage/cost accounting and operational failure monitoring
Separate explicit governance decision after stable paper evidence; no automatic promotion and no assumption that historical performance guarantees future returns

interpretation.current_positive_evidence: Positive holdout returns exist in the reviewed valid trials, but none has met the complete evidence contract.
interpretation.current_uncertainty_reduction: The project has narrowed the active research space by repeatedly observing the same risk/control-relative failure pattern and by showing that the Q016 information-alpha replication was data-insufficient.
interpretation.economic_principle: Use free resources first and spend only when a measurable bottleneck and expected value are demonstrated.
interpretation.financial_context: 500 EUR remains the reference starting capital for later simulation/planning; withdrawal amounts are not fixed and depend on realized, distributable surplus.
interpretation.non_promise: These metrics measure research progress and uncertainty reduction; they do not establish future profitability or financial security.
